description: This file is an Android activity class named MultiRes that displays a series of images and handles user interactions such as navigating through photos and managing activity state.
external_files: ids in layout XML (R.id.next_button, R.id.image_view, R.id.status_text)

classes.name: MultiRes
classes.description: An Android activity providing a simple photo viewer with next button navigation and state restoration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets up the 'Next' button click handler.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current photo index during activity state save.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the photo index when activity state is restored.

methods.name: showPhoto
methods.description: Updates the ImageView and status text to display the selected photo.
